summary_en: 600,700 ordinary shares cancelled (2.8% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Effective 31 July 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury): 21,197,687.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Treasury Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: GLOBERIDE completed the cancellation of 600,700 treasury ordinary shares on 31 July 2026, pursuant to Company Law Article 178 and a board resolution of 13 May 2026. The cancelled shares represented 2.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury. Following the cancellation, the company's issued share count (excluding treasury) is 21,197,687 shares.
